== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[Ninecloud]] City is one of the largest metropolises in the world and serves as the capital of the [[Ninecloud]] country. It is characterized by its vibrant, multicolored appearance, featuring a skyline of glistening, jeweled towers in various hues that can appear like candy. The city is known for its rainbow radiance, which persists even at night due to the glowing nature of its buildings and structures. The city is home to the [[Ninecloud Court]], a ruling entity that utilizes rainbow-colored [[madra]]—a spiritual mutation unique to the Sha bloodline. This power allows for the control of others' spirits and has been used to establish dominance over both the nation and its namesake continent. The [[Court]]'s presence is marked by various architectural wonders, including a crystalline viewing tower made of [[Forged madra]] and stained glass, as well as a jeweled [[Monarch platform]] resting upon rainbow clouds. Governance and security in the city are managed through advanced [[constructs]], specialized [[peacekeepers]] of [[Underlord]] rank, and a sentient entity known as the [[Ninecloud Soul]], which communicates with citizens and guests. The city also utilizes protective [[scripts]] and barriers to maintain security and manage environmental or magical threats.}}

== Wintersteel ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|[[Ninecloud]] City is a location characterized by glistening, brightly colored towers and structures that sit beneath a rose-tinted crystal roof. This city features hangars for cloudships, world-renowned entertainment venues, and the [[Akura building]], while also housing the tree for the [[Heart-Piercer Fruit]]. As a place with its own unique laws, it hosts celebrations during the Uncrowned King Tournament{{!}}Uncrowned tournament and contains a guest tower belonging to [[Northstrider]]. During recent events, [[Lindon]] and his companions emerged within the city, where an invisible column restriction settled around the area. This boundary resulted in [[Reigan Shen]] being sent flying out of the city, and four [[Monarchs]] remain bound to [[Ninecloud]] City.}}
